data.name: Master Protocol Framework Objective
data.text: The main purpose of the CAMPFIRE Master Protocol is to create a framework to seamlessly evaluate the efficacy and safety of each investigational agent or study drug regimen eligible for development in specified populations of pediatric and young adult patients.

data.name: Investigation-Specific Endpoints
data.text: The clinical research objectives and endpoints for specific investigations are detailed in each individual addendum.

data.name: Investigation-Specific Efficacy Estimand (Master Protocol Framework)
data.populationSummary: Pediatric and young adult patients with cancer meeting investigation-specific eligibility criteria as defined in each individual addendum (Investigation-specific analysis population as defined in each addendum (e.g., Intent-to-Treat or modified Intent-to-Treat population)) Summary measure: Investigation-specific summary measure as defined in each addendum statistical analysis plan (e.g., objective response rate, hazard ratio, difference in means).

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of study treatment
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient discontinues investigational study treatment prior to the planned end of treatment as defined in the addendum, due to adverse events, disease progression, withdrawal of consent, or investigator decision

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of prohibited concomitant therapy
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient initiates prohibited or restricted concomitant therapy as specified in the addendum-specific list of restricted and prohibited concomitant therapies

intercurrentEvents.name: Death
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient dies prior to the planned efficacy assessment timepoint as defined in the addendum

intercurrentEvents.name: Disease progression requiring alternative therapy
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient experiences disease progression and initiates alternative anticancer therapy outside of the study treatment regimen prior to the planned efficacy assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient undergoes dose reduction or dose interruption of the investigational agent as specified in the addendum-specific dose modification guidelines

data.treatment: Lilly investigational drug(s) alone or in combination with available treatments or other investigational agents vs. comparator/control arm as specified in each individual addendum
data.analysisPopulation: Investigation-specific analysis population as defined in each addendum (e.g., Intent-to-Treat or modified Intent-to-Treat population)
data.variableOfInterest: Investigation-specific efficacy and safety endpoints as defined in each individual addendum
data.summaryMeasure: Investigation-specific summary measure as defined in each addendum statistical analysis plan (e.g., objective response rate, hazard ratio, difference in means)
